cases.procedure: FUNCTION Probe(D:IfcDirection):INTEGER; LOCAL N:INTEGER; END_LOCAL; N:=D.Dim; D.DirectionRatios:=[1.0,2.0,3.0]; RETURN(N*10+D.Dim); END_FUNCTION;
FUNCTION Probe(V:IfcVector):INTEGER; LOCAL N:INTEGER; END_LOCAL; N:=V.Dim; V.Orientation.DirectionRatios:=[1.0,2.0]; RETURN(N*10+V.Dim); END_FUNCTION;
FUNCTION Probe(Source:IfcDirection):INTEGER; LOCAL D:IfcDirection; N:INTEGER; END_LOCAL; D:=IfcDirection([1.0,2.0]); N:=D.Dim; D.DirectionRatios:=[1.0,2.0,3.0]; RETURN(N*10+D.Dim); END_FUNCTION;

FUNCTION Probe(A:IfcAxis2Placement3D):REAL; LOCAL V:IfcDirection; R:REAL; END_LOCAL; V:=A.P[1]; V.DirectionRatios[1]:=9.0; R:=A.P[1].DirectionRatios[1]; RETURN(V.DirectionRatios[1]*10+R); END_FUNCTION;
